**PotentialWarp 1.1.0**

- **Edit the patterns.** A new **EDIT** page: tap a step, then what it does (straight, silent, 1/2 or 1/4 speed, tape stop or start, backwards, spinback, repeat 1/8 to 1/64). Every pad can be changed, the pad's name shows EDITED, and **RESET PAD** puts its own pattern back.
- **Dice.** **ROLL** makes a new pattern for the pad, on the beat. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** says how far it goes.
- **Chains.** A new **CHAIN** page: up to 8 patterns played in turn, one LENGTH each, so the warp changes over a phrase by itself. The pads follow the chain.
- The strip shows the pattern step by step, so edited and rolled patterns show as they are.
- Edited patterns and the chain are saved with your project. Projects from 1.0.x open as before.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialWarp-1.1.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwarp/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialWarp-1.1.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialWarp-1.1.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialWarp-1.1.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwarp/issues/new/choose).
